name: cpu-8080
description: Intel 8080 assembly for z88dk: original ISA (April 1974), Zilog mnemonics, Pastraiser opcode/flag/timing map (S Z 0 A 0 P 1 C), stack-only locals, no 8085 extras, no Z80 IX/IY/exx. `jr` is a jp synthetic (normal mode). Use when writing or reviewing 8080 library asm, +cpm -clib=8080, -m8080, mapping Intel↔Zilog, unused *NOP slots, pop-af return-address traps, or /cpu-8080. Parent of 8085, KR580VM1, gbz80, and Z80.
